pyqs.independentSolution: In free space E=cB=3e8*2e-7=60 V/m. Direction must satisfy E cross B along +x. (−k) cross j = +i. Original x-direction is stated explicitly as +x in adaptation, consistent with final key.

A constant phase gives dx/dt=νλ>0. Since B is along j with scalar sine factor, E has negative k coefficient. Magnitude factor speed νλ. The cross product is +i times νλ B₀² sin², so direction holds when both fields reverse.

targetQuestionText: An electromagnetic wave travels through free space along +x. At one point and instant, its magnetic field is 2 × 10⁻⁷ T along +y. What is the electric field there?
